title: Northstar Workshop: equipment checkout
text:
This fictional guide is for a synthetic demonstration only.
Before moving equipment, inspect the case for visible damage.
If the case is damaged, stop and notify the shift lead. Do not move damaged equipment.
Record the equipment identifier and checkout time in the checkout log before leaving the storage area.
Only trained staff may use the blue handling cart.
Return equipment to shelf B at the end of the shift.
For a missing identifier, notify the shift lead before checkout.
The shift lead and the facilities coordinator can both answer general storage questions.
Never enter a personal password in the checkout log.
